sections.text_helper: Section 14.5 "LPDMA in debug mode" in chapter 14 (Low-power direct memory access controller (LPDMA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 420.
sections.section_content:
When the microcontroller enters debug mode (core halted), any channel x can be
individually either continued (default) or suspended, depending on the programmable
control bit in the DBGMCU module.
Note: In debug mode, LPDMA_CxSR.SUSPF is not altered by a suspension from the
programmable control bit in the DBGMCU module. In this case, LPDMA_CxSR.IDLEF can
be checked to know the completion status of the channel suspension.
